correctness.rationale: Forward invariance of 0<=y<=x<=1 and conserved Q=(y-g(x))/(1-x)^beta lead to exact basin classification; direct differentiation gives g' strictly increasing and g''>0 for all beta>0. The cost is strictly convex on [a,r], so its unique minimizer switches exactly at lambda_c=-g'(a). Lambert-W identity follows from t log t=r/(1-r). The boundary does not produce an outbreak; every larger budget permits a perturbation above the curve. The executable checks reproduce finite example and numerical comparisons, not the infinite-parametric proof.

value.rationale: This closes an explicitly motivated decision problem not answered by a dynamics-only phase portrait: choose how much expensive public advocacy to buy versus cheap silent support and give the exact strict budget threshold. It yields a complete robust all-parameter classification, a mathematically sharp composition transition, and an essential nonattainment limit; it is not an arbitrary parameter census or a re-named basin theorem. Scope is deliberately limited to one-shot well-mixed deterministic interventions.
